mapper.select: SELECT b.*, u.nickname as author_name, u.avatar as author_avatar, c.name as category_name FROM tb_blog b LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON b.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_blog SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_blog SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tb_blog SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
